finalists.label: Choriocarcinoma
finalists.why: It has strong for evidence, including high β-hCG levels and poorly differentiated tumor composed of syncytial, intermediate in situ trophoblastic cells.

finalists.label: Metastatic Testicular Cancer
finalists.why: It has some for evidence, including numerous pulmonary nodules, but is less specific than Choriocarcinoma.

frontier_selector.why: The high β-hCG levels and specific tumor composition in the vignette decided the final comparison in favor of Choriocarcinoma.

support_spans: Initial serum β-hCG: 691 IU/L (normal 0-5 IU/L), increased to 1860 IU/L on repeat
Poorly differentiated tumor composed of syncytial, intermediate in situ trophoblastic cells

contradict_spans: Normal levels: Morning cortisol, ACTH, aldosterone, renin, DHEA sulfate, testosterone, 17-hydroxyprogesterone
